assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: professional hand-drawn 2D anime animation sprite atlas for a transparent desktop character. High quality dramatic anime linework, crisp cel shading, detailed consistent anatomy, polished animation production drawings, no pixel art, no chibi. EXACTLY SIXTEEN separate FULL-BODY illustrations of this ONE character in a STRICT 4 columns by 4 rows regular grid on a genuinely transparent alpha background. Each figure is completely contained in its cell, feet and hair fully visible, consistent character size and same costume in every cell, at least 60 transparent pixels separating silhouettes. All face RIGHT in a side / slight three-quarter view appropriate to moving right on screen, feet at a shared baseline within each row. Row 1, left to right: four chronological WALK cycle keyframes: right foot reaches forward, right-foot planted passing pose, left foot reaches forward, left-foot planted passing pose. Row 2: four chronological RUN cycle keyframes: forward lean long stride right forward, compact push-off, forward lean long stride left forward, compact airborne recovery. Row 4: four chronological TRANSFORMATION initiation keyframes: kneel with resolve, bring right hand to mouth, bite hand with concentrated resolve without visible blood, brace forcefully on the ground surrounded by a tiny warm edge light attached to silhouette. Keep the same human in every cell, do not show a titan yet. No text, labels, grid lines, backdrop, ground shadows, scene, other people, duplicate tiny detached figures, weapons separate from hands, or detached decorative sparks. Each cell must contain exactly ONE connected alpha silhouette.
